scope: Same 20 already exposed historical English child-speech clips; printed references and expert ratings, not pure ASR WER
source: SpeechOcean762, Zhang et al., Interspeech 2021; CC BY 4.0 per OpenSLR SLR101; attribution retained in evidence/LIVE_VALIDATION.md
changed_parameter: beam_size 1 to 5; same base weights, CPU/thread configuration, scoring, thresholds and sample
preliminary_runs: Five controls and 20 exposed historical clips first checked an earlier runner revision. Final source-bound comparison reran five controls and the baseline/candidate historical set; all repeats are development exposure.
interpretation: Modest exposed-sample signal: 5 fewer acceptable words flagged, same 4/5 expert-error flags and 2 fewer prompt edits. Remaining disagreement is high; beam5 was slower in this run. No general recognition or pronunciation-quality claim.
privacy: Only reviewed aggregate outcomes and receipt hashes published; new transcripts, audio, manifests, per-reader results and SQLite exposure ledger stay private
